grade_rationale: 2 P1 CVEs (CVSS 9.8) exceed Grade B threshold (max_p1=0). Fits Grade C: max_p1=2, 5 P2s ≤ 15, 82% spec coverage ≥ 40%.

escalations.title: Handlebars JavaScript Template Injection — Arbitrary Code Execution
escalations.summary: Arbitrary code execution via malformed Handlebars templates. Any attacker who can influence template strings (test fixtures, committed template files, CI env injection) can execute arbitrary JS in the Node.js process. Full CI secret exfiltration risk.

escalations.title: protobufjs Arbitrary Code Execution — RCE in Agent Orchestration Infrastructure
escalations.summary: Prototype pollution in protobufjs allows RCE via specially crafted .proto file or serialised message. Affects the orchestration layer that dispatches all agent teams. Compromise = full control over AI pipeline.
escalations.remediation: npm update @opentelemetry/sdk-node @opentelemetry/exporter-trace-otlp-http @opentelemetry/auto-instrumentations-node (in platform/orchestrator AND portal/Backend). Note: platform/ requires solo-session access.

backlog.title: Traceability enforcer blind spot for portal/ and platform/
backlog.summary: Enforcer scans only Source/. The dev-workflow-platform.md spec (84 FRs, 653 Verifies comments in portal/) is invisible to the enforcer, producing false-green CI output. The tiered-merge-pipeline.md spec (10 FRs in platform/) is also unscanned.
backlog.remediation: Add portal/ to source.dirs in inspector.config.yml. Update enforcer to iterate all Plans/*/requirements.md (not just most-recently-modified). Add CI step: python3 tools/traceability-enforcer.py --file Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md

backlog.title: Direct DB calls in teamDispatches route handler
backlog.summary: Three inline SQL queries (db.prepare(...).all(), db.prepare(...).run()) inside the route handler. CLAUDE.md rule: 'No direct DB calls from route handlers — use the service layer.' No teamDispatchService module exists.
backlog.remediation: Extract teamDispatchService.ts with listDispatches(filter) and createDispatch(data) functions. Route handler calls service only. Add // Verifies: FR-XXX once owning spec FR is assigned.

backlog.title: Empty .catch() silently swallows API failures in RepoSelector
backlog.summary: repos.list().then(r => setKnownRepos(r.data)).catch(() => {}) — empty catch discards API failures with no log, no user feedback. CLAUDE.md: 'Never swallow errors silently.'
backlog.remediation: Replace with .catch((err) => { console.warn('repos.list failed, using defaults', err) }) at minimum, or propagate to component error state.

backlog.title: path-to-regexp ReDoS — Denial of Service via malformed route parameters
backlog.summary: path-to-regexp vulnerable to catastrophic backtracking (ReDoS) via specially crafted route parameter strings. Unauthenticated DoS if route handlers are publicly accessible.
backlog.remediation: npm update express (in platform/orchestrator AND portal/Backend)

backlog.title: picomatch ReDoS — Build-time DoS via extglob quantifiers
backlog.summary: picomatch vulnerable to ReDoS via extglob quantifier patterns. Primarily a build-time risk but can be triggered by malicious glob patterns.

backlog.remediation: Add dependency_check_duration_seconds Histogram to metrics.ts with // Verifies: FR-dependency-metrics comment. Add test case to metrics.test.ts.

backlog.title: Enforcer regex generates false-positive IDs from spec prose seed data
backlog.summary: Regex FR-[A-Z0-9-]+ matches seed data item IDs (FR-0002, FR-0003, etc.) from spec prose, producing false MISSING results.
backlog.remediation: Tighten regex to require IDs at line/cell boundaries: (^|\s|\|)FR-[A-Z][A-Z0-9-]+. Validate extracted IDs against known naming patterns.
